name: shakers
description: All-in-one local Shakers connector: scan your AI usage, build your profile, find projects, register, onboard, certify and ask Alma — the full toolset runs on your machine and talks to Shakers over HTTP with your CLI login.
long_description: A local MCP server exposing the complete Shakers talent toolset. The local scan tools (ai_usage, read_cv, suggest_register_context) run on-device with on-device redaction; the server-backed tools (profile, projects, applications, certifications, register, onboarding, roles, Alma) call hub/certs over HTTP authenticated with your Shakers CLI session. Includes slash-command prompts for the key actions.

tools.name: ai_usage
tools.description: Scan this machine's AI-tool sessions + git repos and (with consent) submit the redacted AI-usage report to Shakers.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Your Shakers profile: role, rate, and 'My work with AI'.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Find open Shakers positions matched to you.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Register and set up your Shakers talent profile.

tools.name: onboarding_interview_start
tools.description: Start the onboarding interview (LiveKit; degrades if the optional native dep is absent).

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask Alma, the Shakers AI assistant.

tools.name: read_cv
tools.description: Read a CV file you confirmed is yours (local, with permission).

tools.name: suggest_register_context
tools.description: Content-free local hints (timezone, git identity, CV candidates) to speed up registration.
